title: Mini Lip Pulse Lip Plumper Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Hydrating✓ Clean at Sephora✓ High Shine Finish✓ Without Silicones✓ Plumping
What it is: A set of three mini high-impact clean lip plumpers with a warming-cooling tingle for visibly fuller, glassy lips.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Capsicum Frutescens (Chili Pepper) Fruit Extract and Ginger Root Oil: Boost blood flow to visibly plump.
- Menthyl Nicotinate and Vanillyl Butyl Ether: Warm and tingle.
- Menthyl Lactate: Cools and refreshes.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance.

What Else You Need to Know: Custom plumping complex delivers a sensorial experience for natural
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply within the perimeter of lips where plumping is desired.
-Tingling sensation may vary. Temporary redness may occur if applied outside the lips.
Ingredients+
-Capsicum Frutescens (Chili Pepper) Fruit Extract and Ginger Root Oil: Boost blood flow to visibly plump.
-Menthyl Nicotinate and Vanillyl Butyl Ether: Warm and tingle.
-Menthyl Lactate: Cools and refreshes.

Aura Flare:
Polybutene, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Dextrin Palmitate, Dextrin Palmitate/Ethylhexanoate, Menthyl Nicotinate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil Unsaponifiables, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Menthyl Lactate, Methyl Nicotinate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Vanillyl Butyl Ether, Canola Oil, Capsicum Frutescens Fruit Extract, Zingiber Officinale (Ginger) Root Oil, Menthol, Tin Oxide, Vanillin, Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate, Fragrance (Parfum) [+/-: Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410)].
